quiz_title: Quiz 2: Arrays, Extrema, In-Place Reversal & Frequency

questions.title: Second Largest Element in Array
questions.problem_statement:
Given an array of N integers, find the strictly second largest distinct element.
If no strictly second largest element exists (e.g. all elements are identical, or N < 2), print `-1`.

### Input Format
First line: Integer `N` (1 <= N <= 1000).
Second line: `N` space-separated integers.

### Output Format
Print the second largest distinct integer or `-1` followed by a newline.

questions.title: In-Place Array Reversal
questions.problem_statement:
Given an array of N integers, reverse the elements in-place and print the reversed array.

### Input Format
First line: Integer `N` (1 <= N <= 1000).
Second line: `N` space-separated integers.

### Output Format
Print the reversed array with elements separated by single spaces, followed by a newline.

questions.title: Majority Element in Array
questions.problem_statement:
Given an array of N integers, find the element that appears strictly more than floor(N / 2) times.
If no such majority element exists, print `-1`.

### Input Format
First line: Integer `N` (1 <= N <= 1000).
Second line: `N` space-separated integers.

### Output Format
Print the majority element or `-1` followed by a newline.
